description: This source file defines the ModifyFeaturesStrategy class which handles ModifyFeatures commands in a Ditto-based application, managing feature modifications within Thing entities by generating appropriate events and responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: Implements the handling of ModifyFeatures commands, applying modifications or creating new features, and generating corresponding events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main method to handle the ModifyFeatures command, determining whether to modify existing features or create new features in the Thing.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Generates the result when modifying existing features of a Thing.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Generates the result when creating new features in a Thing.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the previous state of the features.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the updated features state.
